# Historical paper records

This directory retains historical records that still support tests or provenance:

- `protein_variable_gamma_theta_20261028.zip` and its checksum: the original
  four/five-parameter uncertainty fixture replayed by `test/protein_publication.py`.
- `04_protein_crystallization/`: the failed calibration pilot identified as the
  training source of the frozen compatibility preconditioner.
- `producer_snapshots/`: captured source hashes, working-tree patch and solver
  records identifying historical producers.

Their original bytes are unchanged. Current protein samples live at
`paper/protein/data/{cnt,cnt_grd,cnt_growth_grd}/`. Paths recorded inside old
archives describe their original checkout, not the current layout.

Other retired growth, tubular and protein studies, obsolete paper moments and
growth figures, development pilots and former entry points have been relocated
to the external recovery archive. See the [archive catalogue](../README.md#relocated-legacy-outputs)
and [file manifest](../relocated_assets_20261103.json). Their original nested
archives, producer records and checksums are preserved there. The manual's
moment case remains active.
